Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value from activities for human single-protein target CHEMBL1870. Join activities to assays on assay_id, assays to target_dictionary on tid, and activities to molecule_dictionary then compound_structures on molregno for canonical_smiles. Filter to standard_type = 'IC50', standard_relation = '=', and pchembl_value is not null. Do not deduplicate; keep every qualifying activity row. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit to 1000 rows.
